content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Leavenworth

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for PMP® eligibility. Most candidates need a bachelor's degree plus a defined number of hours leading projects. Review PMI's official eligibility guidelines or contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Boot Camp. This formally approved course delivers the required contact hours through interactive, expert-led sessions designed to build your project-management knowledge and exam readiness in a structured, accountable environment.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP® application directly with PMI, including documentation of your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process and answer procedural questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice assessments, and instructor feedback to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your proctored PMP® exam through PMI's testing partner and take the test at your preferred location and time window.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education and PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing professional development and recertification.
